apps.name: Relaxin
apps.subtitle: Semi-untethered jailbreak, iOS 17.0-17.3.1
apps.localizedDescription: Semi-untethered jailbreak built on Dopamine-roothide. Supports iOS 17.0-17.3.1 on A12-A17 Pro and M1/M2. Closed source. Superseded by Dopamine 3.0 on the same firmwares.

versions.localizedDescription: Improved jailbreak reliability on A17 devices. Improved compatibility when automatic device analysis is unavailable. Fixed apps being modified when their launch policy should leave them unchanged. Added an animated terminal-style background on supported devices.

apps.name: Dopamine
apps.subtitle: Rootless jailbreak, iOS 15-26.0.1
apps.localizedDescription: Open-source rootless semi-untethered jailbreak by Lars Fröder (opa334). iOS 15.0-17.3.1 on arm64e, iOS 15.0-18.7.1 on arm64, and iOS 26.0-26.0.1 on A12/A13. Works with Sileo and Zebra.

versions.localizedDescription: Fix posix_spawn hook attribute struct changes persisting after return (fixes Zebra on iOS 17.6+). Improve SpringBoard snapshot redirect logic in rootlesshook.
